Name: Smart_RFL
Description: Will create a fancy RFL system for current Feet

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Will create a fancy RFL system for current Feet. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. AltMode: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. TransferAttrs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. SetRFLAttrsPosition: set the node/object name this block should use. SetFootBlockName: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
